name: Canadian Energy Research Institute (CERI) studies
notes: Independent energy-economics institute known for oil-sands supply-cost studies (e.g. Study 152: SAGD C$58.65/bbl, mining C$70.18/bbl, 2015). DOMAIN DEAD/SQUATTED as of 2026-10-29 (ceri.ca now serves an unrelated environmental group) - studies circulate via NRCan and partner PDF mirrors; the Canada Commons profile is the publishing index. Some full PDFs open (Study 150 on NRCan), newer ones paid. Evidence: web search 2026-10-29 incl. NRCan-hosted Study 150 PDF.
